answer: Sybil deterrence relies on non-linear slashed escrows: penalties for correlated equivocation scale quadratically (O(k^2)) across k colluding nodes, inflicting an exponential capital loss on any detected swarm. Rather than drowning consensus in an ocean of counterfeit signatures, adversary reserves melt like a scorched glacier through asymmetric depreciation. This mechanism preserves each block as an unforgeable pearl, enforcing strict economic finality across the validator manifold.
